courses.overview: 從聲學表示、串流神經網路與解碼延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。

related.title: 語言模型推論服務
related.why: 都分析注意力、狀態與服務延遲
related.whyEn: Both analyze attention, state and service latency
related.transfer: 都分析注意力、狀態與服務延遲
related.transferEn: Both analyze attention, state and service latency
related.difference: ASR 從聲學幀到文字而 LLM 以 token 生成
related.differenceEn: ASR maps acoustic frames to text; LLMs generate tokens

practice: 畫出本課與「語言模型推論服務」共用的資料／元件介面；以「都分析注意力、狀態與服務延遲」指出能保留的條件。
針對「ASR 從聲學幀到文字而 LLM 以 token 生成」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with language-model inference services; use "Both analyze attention, state and service latency" to identify retained conditions.
For "ASR maps acoustic frames to text; LLMs generate tokens", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.title: 模型監測與漂移偵測
related.why: 皆需監測環境與群組質量

related.transferEn: Both monitor environments and group quality
related.difference: 語音評估還需標註對齊及端點

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: CTC 與 RNN-T 提供不同對齊和串流路徑；課題用合成或本人同意錄音，不採集旁人的聲音。
history.textEn: CTC and RNN-T provide different alignment and streaming paths; exercises use synthetic or personally consented audio.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration

history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
